channel.title: Tesseract
channel.description: The AIOS — a client to Celestia.

item.title: Version 1.71.0
item.description: Widgets for Apollo, Meridian and Alaura on iPhone and Mac: lists, planner, calendar, sleep, water and food, with interactive buttons, plus Control Center buttons.

item.title: Version 1.70.0
item.description: Cerebro: long threads open in one pass instead of replaying, and the context ring opens a flat usage panel.

item.title: Version 1.69.0
item.description: Cerebro: instant Allow and Deny, flat black interface with a resizable inspector, no replay flash when opening a thread, archive threads, bold around code renders, stopped tools read as stopped.

item.title: Version 1.68.0
item.description: Diagnostics: the thread stream traces events it cannot decode, and Probe reports how many events of each kind a conversation received.

item.title: Version 1.67.0
item.description: Diagnostics for click-to-preview of produced files; everything from 1.66 (no freeze on the macOS privacy prompt).

item.title: Version 1.66.0
item.description: A pending macOS privacy prompt no longer freezes the app (orb designs load in the background). Plus click-to-preview for any file an agent makes, and everything from 1.63.

item.title: Version 1.65.0
item.description: Click any file an agent made and it opens in the right-hand panel: images, PDF, HTML, Markdown, CSV, text, and Word/Excel/PowerPoint/Pages/audio/video through Quick Look. Plus hidden halves hidden from VoiceOver.

item.title: Version 1.64.0
item.description: Hidden halves are hidden from VoiceOver (and from Probe's tree). Everything from 1.63.0: questions and plans, inspector, tool cards, Cmd-K, Shift-Tab modes, find, export, Allow/Deny notifications, Skills, subagents, the new-thread wizard.

item.title: Version 1.63.0
item.description: Cerebro: questions and plans (answer cards, a plan you can approve), an inspector (plan, changes, outputs, context, tasks), tool calls as one card with rows and diffs, Worked-for folds, Cmd-K search and navigation, Shift-Tab modes, find, export, Allow/Deny on notifications, a Skills section, subagents, the new-thread wizard.

item.title: Version 1.62.0
item.description: Cerebro: opaque background, approval card sized to its command, internal commands hidden from the / menu.

item.title: Version 1.61.0
item.description: Cerebro (⌃⌘3): talk to any agent in its workspace or any folder, Claude Code style — approval cards for tool calls, Retry/Continue in place, model/effort/mode mid-thread, a context ring with every heart's usage, / skills and @ files. iPhone answers approvals.

item.title: Version 1.60.0
item.description: The heart name under an agent's orb is a dropdown: pick Claude or an Arc-Code heart right there

item.title: Version 1.59.0
item.description: Engine writes Phoebe makes in Aether show as a receipt in the owning agent's colour, with Undo.

item.title: Version 1.58.0
item.description: Spectra: Saga's second app — a Plex client on iPhone and Mac. Plays your real files (direct play, Plex HLS fallback), search, resume, audio/subtitle/quality choices, offline downloads, Who's watching, Phoebe can play things, and a Just added by Saga row.

item.title: Version 1.57.0
item.description: Split View: View ▸ Split Right (⌘\) puts two live Tesseracts side by side in one window — drag the notch to resize, double-click for halves, drag a pane off the edge to close it. Drag and drop between panes and windows: an Apollo task onto a Meridian day schedules it, a canon file onto another agent's chat references it. File ▸ New Window now opens a truly separate window. Smoother everywhere: orbs no longer stall the app waiting on the GPU.

item.title: Version 1.56.0
item.description: iPhone apps: real tab bars (swipe between tabs), Apollo's list cards snap one at a time, the dial opens with a thumb arcing from the right edge left and down, sheets tinted with each app's colour, and opening one app from inside another now lands in it.

item.title: Version 1.55.0
item.description: iPhone: every app is a real app. Apps open out of their icon on the Apps page (now the second home page) and fill the whole screen with nothing of Tesseract's around them. A four-finger pinch takes you home; an arc out of the bottom-right corner brings PhoebeOS's dial and a switcher of your live apps. Apps stay where you left them. Go Home shortcut for the Action Button.

item.title: Version 1.54.0
item.description: Voice: the mic works again with echo cancellation on.

item.title: Version 1.53.0
item.description: Voice: echo cancellation now starts, so she stops hearing herself.

item.title: Version 1.52.0
item.description: Voice: a ring on the orb shows what the mic hears.

item.title: Version 1.51.0
item.description: Voice: rules answer in under a second; long requests aren't cut into pieces; faster turns.

item.title: Version 1.50.0
item.description: Talk to Phoebe like a person: an open mic, instant answers, talk over her, agents work in the background and report back.

item.title: Version 1.49.0
item.description: Meridian on a client: the month grid no longer falls back to the top of its window after a jump, and it reads only the months near where you are instead of every month it lays out. Probe gains app.open so a session can open the screen it is testing.

item.title: Version 1.48.0
item.description: Probe: Settings > Probe lets a Claude session see and drive this app on this device (state, the screen as text, taps, scrolls, scenarios, a slow-network simulator), so features are tested on real devices without screenshots. Meridian narrates its navigation and reads into the trace.

item.title: Version 1.47.0
item.description: Meridian on other Macs: month and year navigation land where you asked (no more jumping to 2024 or 2028), calendar reads are batched, a client that starts before its connection is ready recovers and says when it is offline, and events drag between days in every view.

item.title: Version 1.46.0
item.description: Meridian at Timepage quality: one calendar from the home Mac (instant, offline-safe, never duplicated); click any event or task for its card; a day click slides the panel in over a dimmed grid; right-click a day for a new event, a new Apollo task, or to schedule one; smoother grid and month jumps; real weather; today's month stays the white block; the dock gets an agents/apps chip and the Apps button is gone; choosing a picture for an app works; iPhone gets the same card, menus and forecast.

item.title: Version 1.45.0
item.description: Meridian: events come straight from EventKit (live, no blank flashes); real popovers for the editor, search, inbox, themes and the N-more list; the day panel can be put away; month and year jumps land instead of scrolling past every month; the + appears in place of the day number; clicking + no longer beach-balls; real weather forecast; iPhone uses the system event editor.

item.title: Version 1.44.0
item.description: Meridian: actions are Apollo's tasks (click opens the card with checklist pills, drag to reorder or drop on a day, instant offline-safe edits); new iPhone Meridian (Week, Day, Month, Year, Search, event sheet, customization); offline and error banners.

item.title: Version 1.43.0
item.description: Talk to Phoebe from the iPhone Action Button; Phoebe understands everyday names (sleep, water, food, spending, to do list) and finds places on-device for free; new Apps tab: agent domains as circles on OLED black, zoom in, set any app's picture (saved for every client); app chips on the Dashboard's agent cards; Apollo edits are instant through an offline outbox.

item.title: Version 1.42.0
item.description: Apollo feels instant: edits land in place without a reload, cards no longer jump or reflow, and a refused completion comes back.

item.title: Version 1.41.0
item.description: Apollo on iPhone looks and works like Actions: Schedule, Lists (rows or cards), full-colour lists, action card sheets, swipe to complete or delete with Undo, long-press menu, drag between days, pull to create.

item.title: Version 1.40.0
item.description: Apollo on the Mac looks and works like Actions: Schedule column (Structured · Free), tall list columns, a floating action card, drag to schedule, move and reorder.

item.title: Version 1.39.0
item.description: Apollo: Actions' checklist (tinted rows, ring fills white, n/m progress) replaces the white subtask pills; the shared Actions kit lands for both Mac and iPhone.

item.title: Version 1.38.0
item.description: Apollo's dates now live on Meridian: tasks and deadlines mirror to an Apollo calendar both ways. Deadline, Someday and reminders arrive on the task model.

item.title: Version 1.37.0
item.description: Tasks: subtasks under each task, drag to reorder, move between lists or into the planner, instant checks, cleaner task editor.

item.title: Version 1.36.0
item.description: The heart in the orb: a core glowing in its heart's colour, click the orb to change it. Settings ▸ Usage for Claude's plan limits, OpenRouter credits and Lite's free allowances. Canonical colours: Claude orange, Frontier yellow, Lite green. Much cooler: idle orbs paced by size, hidden halves and Aether's background still. Aether now sits left of Tesseract.

item.title: Version 1.35.0
item.description: Aether: Tesseract's chat-and-projects half. Hover the top middle to switch. Plain-Claude chats that hand work to your agents, projects in any folder on the home Mac with a team, instructions, memory, locked files, a files panel and per-turn diffs with revert. On the phone too. Needs Celestia 1.28.

item.title: Version 1.34.0
item.description: Agent orbits in layers — skills and fabricators ring the orb, MCP connectors ring them, with living lines. Connectors are first-class: connect Notion, PubMed, Linear or any MCP server to an agent, signed in through Supabase.

item.title: Version 1.33.0
item.description: Shared groundwork for Tesseract on iPhone: hands-free voice turns, spoken replies from typed messages, and the app catalog shared between Mac and phone.

item.title: Version 1.32.0
item.description: Hearts: Settings ▸ Hearts carousel, a heart badge under every agent's orb, and a heart button in the composer. Fabricators run at the touch of a button with a live run panel, a heart per step, and their gate answered right on the page. Saga's Home shows its step subagents as orbs.

item.title: Version 1.31.0
item.description: Dashboard: PhoebeOS's Planner, Meridian's month, the Glow chart and every agent's domain. Phoebe Mind, Phoebe hands work to Friday, always-on Phoebe, cancel with ✕ or 'never mind'. Alaura's own Today, the sleep dial, the water circle and Energia's goal rings. Agents open on their own tab.

item.title: Version 1.30.0
item.description: Hold the talk key to talk, double-press for hands-free, press again to send — and the key can be Option on its own. Click the orb to talk. See what you're saying while you say it. The orb keeps its colours. 'Hey Apollo' reaches Friday.

item.title: Version 1.29.0
item.description: Battery: orbs no longer run flat out — they pace themselves (30 fps idle, 60 while thinking), slow down in the background or Low Power Mode, and stop entirely when nobody can see them; Atelier materials render once per frame per material. Alaura's apps: Akeso (sleep, naps, morning and bedtime checklists), Hydros (water and electrolytes) and Energia (meals, goals, plan, menu, grocery) — PhoebeOS's modules, now engines under her. Alaura joins the Council.

item.title: Version 1.28.0
item.description: Phoebe does things by rule — open Hermes, remind me to pay the rent tomorrow, what's on my planner, undo that — with no model. Toasts for FabSight runs, approvals, replies and the home Mac's health. Dock orbs click; Bills widget; listening chime; calmer orb; Council and Phoebe settings.

item.title: Version 1.27.0
item.description: A dock and a ⌃⌥Tab orb dial for agents, Apps tabs, the brain glow, Home widgets, Mac notifications and a menu-bar status, and the Council morning report.

item.title: Version 1.26.0
item.description: Voice: say 'hey <agent>' to pick who does it; Ask Phoebe (⌃⌥P or ⌥-click the orb) for anything going on — read-only, answered aloud, not saved.

item.title: Version 1.25.0
item.description: Voice: talking orb, Phoebe routing with change/undo, new Settings with voice keys and shortcuts

item.title: Version 1.24.0
item.description: Voice: the talking orb (⌃⌥O), ⌃⌥Space to talk, 'hey <agent>' listening mode (⌃⌥L), Voice tab per agent

item.title: Version 1.23.0
item.description: Money tab round two: the Dashboard fits the window with grouped, clearly-dated bills; one-offs can be Timely; accounts can be income sources with live balances; transactions are colour-coded and can be grouped and sorted; your own categories with default and per-month Live Off splits; month colours; a vendor registry with search; and every due date synced both ways with Meridian's Moneta calendar. The corner orb no longer blocks clicks near it.

item.title: Version 1.22.0
item.description: Moneta's Money tab, redesigned: Months Overview, a month Dashboard with a money calendar, Bills with one-off (this-month-only) expenses and income edited in place, Transactions with Live Off rings per category, and Settings with net worth, accounts with logos and live balances, and each category's share of Live Off. Glass hover actions on every row; drop a picture on any icon.

item.title: Version 1.21.0
item.description: Moneta's Money tab (Drachmaos ported onto the local ledger: bills, due dates, paid marks, pay links). Friday's engines as orbs under her orb on Home. Brain badge moved under the orb. New Window (Shift-Cmd-N) for multiple Tesseract windows.

item.title: Version 1.20.0
item.description: Friday arrives: one orb over three deterministic engines. Friday's Home is a Unified Today (events, due and overdue tasks, mail that needs you, email → task → block threads); Hermes (read-only Gmail with live reading and local drafts), Apollo (PhoebeOS Rays, ported) and Meridian (the Meridian calendar, ported) each get a tab. Every agent's Home shows its brain — Claude or a deterministic engine. Connections gains MCP Connectors: per-tool Disable / Always ask / Allow, the approvals queue, Gmail read-only connect, and a Discover catalog from the official MCP registry. Needs Celestia 1.16.0.

item.title: Version 1.19.0
item.description: Dashboards: every agent workspace has a Dashboard tab. Agents build dashboards from a fixed set of blocks (charts, tables, stats, notes), and every number comes from a named read-only query over the warehouse, never typed by a model. Built-in dashboards for agent activity, the home Mac, Saga, Stasi, Moneta and Alaura. Tesseract publishes a tesseract-dashboard skill so agents know how to make their own.

item.title: Version 1.18.0
item.description: Canon Files: every agent's ground-truth files, in its workspace beside Home and Interface — its original records (locked), a claims ledger that opens each fact beside the record it quotes, what the agent built, its reference docs, and any vault file you attach. Gallery and list views with PDF, image and note previews; copy, export, lock and unlock. Also: agents new to the roster are announced with a way to customize them, and the Surface catalog, resolver and compact block cards.

item.title: Version 1.17.0
item.description: Stack page: every part of the system as a tree of pulsing lights — Celestia, the server, LaunchAgents, services, Supabase, release channels and every client, this Mac's connection, token and event stream included — with restart buttons. Streams renew their Supabase token before every connection (messages no longer spin forever on an expired token), and a refused thread says why. iPhone client, per-thread model/effort/billing in Interface.

item.title: Version 1.16.0
item.description: Fabricator views show items (3 of 12 titles, each with its own bar) and how much of the tool's output its FabSight lens reads.

item.title: Version 1.15.0
item.description: FabSight: every fabricator's run, seen. The Fabricators tab now runs on it — the running step glows with a progress bar, finished steps check off, failures go red — and a floating status card leads with the run itself (status, steps done, elapsed, why it failed). God State gets a Fabricators row per agent. Needs Celestia 1.13.0.

item.title: Version 1.14.1
item.description: Another go at the gray titlebar: the window now re-applies its transparent settings on its own events (a stateless SwiftUI wrapper could never re-run), and the title and toolbar backdrop are removed with the native modifiers.

item.title: Version 1.14.0
item.description: Fabricators go live: the running step's node glows with a progress bar, finished steps check off, failures go red — plus a floating status card with the current step, percent, ETA and every step's state. The Fabricators tab is now where you watch a pipeline run.

item.title: Version 1.13.0
item.description: Real fix for the gray titlebar (was being re-asserted by SwiftUI's own toolbar management every update, not just failing once). Corner panel no longer flickers on the way to a click, and its rows get a hover outline. Pipelines retired as a top-level tab — the Fabricators telemetry work that replaces it is next.

item.title: Version 1.12.2
item.description: Drop the broken corner-panel notch for a plain, barely-there glass rectangle above-left of the orb. The floating orb now takes over the real window toolbar (hidden while it's active) instead of sitting in a second gray strip underneath it — genuinely transparent, including in fullscreen.

item.title: Version 1.12.1
item.description: Fix the floating orb rendering dead-center instead of pinned to the top, and the corner panel's notch/positioning/hover-close bug — selecting a section closes the panel now, not just moving off it.

item.title: Version 1.12.0
item.description: Agent workspace gets two new looks: the orb floating at top-center with sections that slide out on hover, or pinned in the corner with a real Liquid Glass panel that grows out of it. Pick one in Settings — pure UI, nothing about what a section does changed.

item.title: Version 1.11.0
item.description: God State: expand the Terminals window into a full dashboard — every agent, every tmux session, every headless process, with live cpu/mem, elapsed time, open files and working directory. Work sorts to the top and breathes while it's actually running.

item.title: Version 1.10.0
item.description: New Pipelines tab: every agent's fabricators in one place, pick one and watch it run live, with its own square glyph distinct from an agent's orb.

item.title: Version 1.9.0
item.description: Attach files to a message — images, PDFs, anything — and a file an agent delivers shows up as a download card. The orb and its activity line now track a running thread everywhere, not just the disc pipeline.

item.title: Version 1.8.0
item.description: Threads read like Claude Code's desktop app: replies grouped under the agent, tool runs folded, a live 'working · elapsed' line, Return to steer while it works, Esc to stop. The sidebar says when home can't be reached instead of going blank.

item.title: Version 1.7.0
item.description: New Interface tab: talk to your agents in threads — streamed replies, tool calls you can expand, and your agents' actions right in the composer. Replaces Actions and Runs; the Terminal tab is unchanged.

item.title: Version 1.6.6
item.description: Verifies self-update works correctly after the identity-pinning fix.

item.title: Version 1.6.5
item.description: Fixes a real regression from 1.6.4: the archive silently signed ad-hoc instead of with the real identity once App Sandbox was removed, which broke Sparkle's own signature check and corrupted an in-place auto-update. The signing identity is now pinned explicitly rather than left to Automatic.

item.title: Version 1.6.4
item.description: Verifies self-update still works after removing App Sandbox.

item.title: Version 1.6.3
item.description: Fixes a real blocker: Tesseract could only ever run on the exact Mac it was built on. App Sandbox plus an Apple Development signing identity made Xcode embed a device-locked provisioning profile in every export, so a second Mac got 'The application cannot be opened' with no fix available in System Settings. Sandbox is removed — nothing here needed it.

item.title: Version 1.6.2
item.description: Verifies the self-update path: the first Tesseract release installed entirely by its own updater.

item.title: Version 1.6.1
item.description: Updates install themselves. Tesseract is sandboxed and could never launch its updater's installer, so every update failed at the last step; this is the last release you'll need to install by hand.

item.title: Version 1.6.0
item.description: A setup wizard that finds your home server on your Tailscale network instead of relying on a built-in address, connects, and shows what this Mac and home actually are. Fabricators now live beside the skills in the vault's .claude folder.

item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description: MDS tab drawn live from the home Mac, with Makefile controls, a live console and one-click fixes for health findings. View Data opens a full-screen presentation of everything in Gold, built from the warehouse itself, with real Phoebe orbs.

item.title: Version 1.4.4
item.description: Keeps retrying the connection to home instead of giving up at launch.

item.title: Version 1.4.3
item.description: Reports why the home server refused a credential instead of claiming approval is pending.

item.title: Version 1.4.2
item.description: Reports the real reason an update fails instead of 'Update Error!'.

item.title: Version 1.4.1
item.description: Fixes Tesseract being unable to reach the home server from any Mac other than the home server itself.

item.title: Version 1.4.0
item.description: Diagnostics: one log for every machine, and a Devices tab for the whole fleet.

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description: The app icon, and a connection you can see: the toolbar now carries the home server's own state with the real marks of the services behind it, fetched from their domains rather than drawn. Sign-in assembles rather than appears, and Connections reports what home is actually holding.

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description: Terminals rebuilt on the daemon: one durable tmux session per agent, every terminal visible including ones started from Termius, live state over an event stream instead of polling, and sign-in over Supabase OAuth so a Mac on the tailnet no longer needs pairing approval.

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description: Databases tab (Supabase-Studio-shaped table editor), the Saga Pipeline workspace with a live disc-to-Plex timeline, activity narration, a typable terminal for every agent, and a terminal gallery with reconnect instead of dead-end sessions.

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description: First shipped release: the AIOS workspace, embedded terminal, approvals queue, on-device SQL, Sparkle auto-updates, and Supabase account sign-in.
